prompt: How to keep going when you're unmotivated
response: When you're unmotivated, it's important to focus on the reasons why you're unmotivated. Try to identify the root cause and address it directly. It might be that you're not getting enough sleep or eating well. Focus on these areas and work on improving them. If you're still unmotivated, it might be time to take a break and let your mind rest.
